--- { sistema: vars.currentRule.accion.sistema, basePath: p("oracle-sapi.base-path"), host: p("oracle-sapi.host"), port: p("oracle-sapi.port"), method: vars.currentRule.accion.metodo, path: vars.currentRule.accion.path, body: if(upper(vars.currentRule.accion.metodo) == "POST") payload else {}, headers: { "client_secret" : p('oracle-sapi.security.client-secret'), "client_id" : p('oracle-sapi.security.client-id'), "name": vars.headers.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": vars.headers."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": vars.headers.source, "systemId": vars.headers.systemId }, queryParameters:{}, uriParameters:if(upper(vars.currentRule.accion.metodo) == "GET") payload else {} }
